metadata.scenario: A woman calls for the first time asking how much in-home nursing visits cost. The receptionist says it's $45 per hour for a certified nursing assistant and $65 per hour for a registered nurse. The caller asks about a package discount for 20 hours per week. The receptionist quotes $800 per week for the CNA package. The caller says she needs to check her budget. First-time caller.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi, my name is Eleanor Watson. I’m looking for information about your in-home nursing visits. Of course, Eleanor! We provide different types of nursing services. What specifically are you looking for? I just need to know the costs for nursing visits. Absolutely! Our certified nursing assistants are $45 per hour, and registered nurses are $65 per hour. Okay, that sounds reasonable. Do you offer any package discounts? Yes, we do! If you book 20 hours of service per week with a certified nursing assistant, it would be $800 per week. Hmm, I see. I need to check my budget before I decide. That’s completely understandable, Eleanor. Would you like me to hold this pricing for a few days? Yes, please. That would be helpful. I can also send you an email with all the details. Can I get your email address? Sure, it’s eleanor.watson@email.com. Great! I’ll send you the pricing information and our services. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? Actually, yes. I’d like to know more about your physical therapy services. Our physical therapy sessions are priced between $110 and $140 for a 45 to 60-minute visit. I see, and how often would you recommend those sessions? It really depends on your specific needs, but typically we recommend 1-3 times a week for recovery. That sounds good. Can I also get details on that in the email? Absolutely! I’ll include all the information about physical therapy as well. Thank you so much, Margaret. I appreciate your help. You’re very welcome, Eleanor. I’m here to help, so don’t hesitate to reach out if you have more questions. Will do! Have a great day! You too, Eleanor! Take care.
